children: "It is only natural that there is some discussion now about waiting and seeing how things play out for a little while."

-SoftBank CFO Yoshimitsu Goto, signaling the OpenAI investor's plans to take its foot off the gas after years of aggressive AI investment. The company swung to a $7 billion loss as the AI trade falters.
